Appendix B: Charles River Associates, Impact of the World Implementing the Kyoto Protocol.

Region: Canada (western Canadian upstream oil and gas; Alberta electricity factors). Locators are PDF pages (the Appendix A data sheets carry no usable page numbers): body copy of the $1.50 sheet PDF p.23-24; Appendix A sheets $1.50 PDF p.67-68 and $2.00 PDF p.69-70; technology assumptions PDF p.61-65. Loaded: the Clearstone cost-curve spreadsheet, 62 option rows (53 costed, 9 listed without data). The sheet is wide and splits across two PDF pages; rows were aligned by parsing the fixed-width text and checked against known pairs (oversized compressor replacements cost 750 k$ each in both light-oil and sweet-gas rows; SAGD 500 M$ for 5 projects). One row (crude bitumen field upgrading, "See Hvy Oil Upgrd") has no data line and is omitted. BASIS WARNING: the sheet gives PROGRAMME TOTALS over the whole Canadian industry at an assumed penetration (capital in M$, operating in k$/y, reductions in kt/y), not per-unit costs; programme totals are in _other-values. Per-unit capex, opex-fixed and capacity are derived only where the sheet prints a count of units (replacements, vent tip conversions, sites, field upgraders, projects, plants, drivers, aftercoolers), with the arithmetic in formula. For methane-dominated options (direct CH4 x 21 >= 80% of CO2E) capex and opex are also given per t CH4 avoided per year (programme ratio; CIMS prices methane controls in t CH4). Abatement cost = sign-reversed Value of GHG Reduction at $1.50/GJ conserved waste gas (avoided fuel $2.00/GJ), plus a second process per option at $2.00/GJ; it is after tax and royalty discount factors and net of conserved gas value. Capital and operating inputs are pre-discount. Price year is not stated (publication year 1999 used) and "$" is assumed CAD. Not costed (description rows only): CO2 EOR, heavy-oil and bitumen cogeneration, CO2 recovery from acid gas (insufficient data), three gas-distribution options (no data provided). Oil sands and gas transmission rows are industry estimates (Sect. 3.5 and 3.8) with round numbers. The Options Paper body and Appendix B (CRA macro study: carbon price above $100/t CO2 for the Kyoto target, crude output -27%) hold no technology data.
